question: The Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Yuva Pratibha Samman 2021 was presented to Arushi Mudgal for _________ dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Yuva Pratibha Samman:-**

 
 
• It is a prestigious award given to young and talented performing artists in the field of classical dance and Odissi music.
 
• **The award was presented to Arushi Mudgal for her outstanding performances in Odissi dance.**
 
• She is a disciple of Guru Ratikant Mohapatra and has won several awards for her dance, including the National Dance Award.
